study: Class-imbalance remedies on the frozen FloodNet protocol (added after the original test results; validation-only choices; own freeze before test)

oversample.source: duplicates of target-containing budget images, drawn with replacement

rgan.source: R-GAN renderings of edited budget layouts

oasis.source: OASIS renderings of the same layouts

spade.source: SPADE renderings of the same layouts

dice.loss: weighted cross-entropy + soft Dice over the two target classes (equal weight)

layouts.base: random target-containing budget mask, flipped left-right/up-down/180 degrees (geometry kept)

image_gan.precision: fp32 with TF32 matmul (no bf16 adversarial losses)
image_gan.selection: lowest KID (ResNet-18 avgpool features, polynomial kernel) between real validation images and images generated from validation layouts

spade.perceptual_backbone: ImageNet ResNet-18 (offline cache) instead of VGG-19

tabular_gan.selection: lowest RBF-MMD against validation target-region rows

decision_rule: helps: 95% CI of the seed-mean pooled flooded-mIoU difference vs baseline excludes 0 above, and all 3 seed-matched differences are positive; hurts: CI excludes 0 below and all 3 negative; otherwise no clear effect
unchanged: class weights from the real budget images
the 448-image official test split, scored once after the freeze
